title: Confirm with a live capture that each Claude Code ScheduleWakeup or /loop tick carries a fresh command identity named by the turn's first frame
outcome: Confirm with a live capture that each Claude Code ScheduleWakeup or /loop tick carries a fresh command identity named by the turn's first frame
acceptance: A live stream-json capture from the pinned Claude Code version of at least one ScheduleWakeup tick and two consecutive /loop ticks records whether each tick carries a distinct command uuid and whether that uuid is named by the tick turn's first top-level frame.

The claude_turn_ownership.rs module header cites that capture as the basis for the self-started identity rule, or, if the capture contradicts the rule, a bug item is filed with the capture and the header's claim is narrowed.
